---
description: "Use when writing Markdown: keep structure readable, CommonMark-compatible, and free of prompt meta-commentary."
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

# Shared Markdown

- Use ATX headings with a space after `#` and fenced code blocks with language identifiers.
- Keep lists simple and paths, commands, and identifiers in inline code.
- Use valid links and alt text for images.
- Write durable project content directly; do not include phrases about the prompt or the editing process.
